dossiers.name: Fluidstack Abernathy Data Center
dossiers.summary: A purpose built AI campus at Abernathy, north of Lubbock, developed by TeraWulf with Fluidstack and backed financially by Google. The state certified Anthropic as its qualifying occupant. It is one of two unrelated data center campuses in the same small town.

facts.label: TeraWulf ownership of the joint venture
Location
facts.text: Abernathy, Hale County, north of Lubbock

facts.label: Delivery
facts.text: Expected in the second half of 2026

notes.text: The Comptroller certified Anthropic, PBC as qualifying occupant. TeraWulf's own release places an Anthropic lease at a different campus and describes its majority interest in the Abernathy joint venture as sold to Fluidstack. Both statements can be true about different things and this record does not adjudicate between them.
Google is the financial anchor rather than a tenant, backstopping the lease obligations so the project could raise debt.

dossiers.name: LBB01 Data Center
dossiers.summary: Aligned's Caprock campus, carrying the Lubbock airport code in its name but standing at Abernathy in Hale County. Lambda is the certified occupant. Its cooling is closed loop, which matters here because the campus sits over the Ogallala Aquifer.

facts.label: Address
facts.text: 1498 County Road 315, Abernathy, Texas 79311

facts.label: County
facts.text: Hale County

facts.label: Campus name
facts.text: Caprock campus, first building LBB-01

facts.label: Cooling
facts.text: Delta cubed air cooling arrays with DeltaFlow liquid cooling capability

facts.label: Water design
facts.text: Closed loop chilled water system, with near zero water utilization efficiency claimed by the operator

facts.label: Power
facts.text: Stated as fully renewable by the operator

facts.label: Service date
facts.text: First building slated for the first quarter of 2027

notes.text: Abernathy holds two unrelated data center campuses. This one is Aligned's, with Lambda as occupant. The other is the TeraWulf and Fluidstack building with Anthropic as occupant. Nothing in the state record connects them and nothing separates them either.
The closed loop design is the operator's own claim about protecting the aquifer beneath the site. It is not a figure this record can verify.

gaps: Contracted load for Lambda specifically is not public
Investment figures and job commitments are not public

dossiers.name: Meitner Data Center
dossiers.summary: Google and Intersect Power's power first campus in the Texas Panhandle, built beside its own generation rather than drawing from the grid alone. It is air cooled by design, which in this part of the state is the whole point.

facts.label: Co-located wind, solar and battery storage, stated as more than
Counties
facts.text: Gray and Roberts Counties

facts.label: Nearest town
facts.text: Pampa

facts.label: Cooling
facts.text: Air cooling, with water limited to small scale domestic use

facts.label: Generation mix
facts.text: Majority clean from the first day, with a minority of on site gas for reliability

notes.text: Trade coverage has attached a headline investment figure and a data center load figure to this campus. Neither appears in Google's or Intersect's own announcements, so neither is published here.

The registry owner is IP Meitner DTC, LLC, an Intersect Power affiliate, while the certified occupant is Google LLC. Alphabet has moved to acquire Intersect Power, which would put landlord and occupant under one roof.

dossiers.name: Cipher Black Pearl LLC Data Center
dossiers.summary: Cipher's Winkler County site at Wink, leased to Amazon on the longest and largest single agreement in this batch.

facts.label: Amazon cost overrun threshold per IT megawatt
Location
facts.text: Wink, Winkler County

facts.label: Lease
facts.text: Amazon Data Services, fifteen years with three five year extension options

facts.label: First certification, occupant Cipher Black Pearl LLC
facts.text: Certified for the owner's own use

facts.label: Second certification, occupant Amazon Data Services
facts.text: Re-certified with a hyperscaler as occupant

notes.text: The agreement puts construction cost overruns above a stated threshold per megawatt on Amazon rather than on the landlord, which is unusual enough to be worth noting.

This facility holds two rows in the state registry rather than one. The earlier certification names Cipher itself as occupant and the later one names Amazon. Read together the two rows record a bitcoin site becoming an AI site, in the state's tax file rather than in an announcement.
